notes.title: Fixed (Ver 1.0.5)
notes.notes: Credits content was broken and has been corrected.

notes.title: Reset Leaderboard
notes.notes:
Due to a bug fixed that has affected the game balance, we will reset the leaderboard at 8 AM(PST) on Sep 5.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause, and thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Fixed (Ver 1.0.2)

notes.title: Bug Fix (Ver 1.0.1)
